# Strova Group

> Technology, commerce, and digital growth for growing businesses.

Strova Group is an India-based engineering and digital growth firm delivering high-performance web systems, native Android applications, automated WhatsApp pipelines, and data-driven customer acquisition for Indian and international businesses.

- **Canonical Origin**: https://strovagroups.in
- **Email**: info@strovagroups.in
- **Phone & WhatsApp**: +91 92880 77802 (tel:+919288077802, https://wa.me/919288077802)
- **Headquarters**: Operating from India (Hours: Mon–Sat, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST / UTC+05:30)
- **Leadership & Ownership**: Sarthak Shresht (Founder). Legal owner per Udyam: Babita Kumari, proprietor. Strova Group is a proprietorship of Babita Kumari.
- **MSME Registration**: UDYAM-JH-20-0147452
- **Commercial Model**: Fixed-scope written quotes delivered within 1 business day; 50% advance upon scope agreement and 50% upon staging demonstration prior to final handover. Invoices in INR or USD upon request.

## Divisions

- **Strova Technologies** (https://strovagroups.in/technologies/): High-performance static and hybrid web platforms, native Android applications, custom SaaS dashboards, and official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API automation workflows.
- **Strova Digital** (https://strovagroups.in/digital/): Technical SEO, Core Web Vitals remediation, paid performance advertising (Google Ads, Meta Ads) with server-side CAPI tracking, and B2B inbound lead generation funnels.
- **Strova Commerce** (https://strovagroups.in/commerce/): Headless e-commerce storefronts, conversational WhatsApp catalog checkouts, and multi-channel inventory synchronization (Coming soon).
